title: A vivid prize and its odds
hook: Two stated cases: explore a deliberately flattened probability-weight model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a deliberately flattened probability-weight model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Weight, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a deliberately flattened probability-weight model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy probability-weighting rule is exp(-(-log(P))^Alpha). With P 0.01 and Alpha 0.3, what decision weight results?

provenance.sourceEntryOriginal: - **269.** Emotionally vivid prizes, like a kiss from a film star, make people less sensitive to probability (Rottenstreich & Hsee, 2001).
